candidates.title: Send a triggered email through Make

demandEvidence.chore: send an email through DigitalAka when a trigger occurs in another app
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: send an email through DigitalAka when a trigger occurs in another app

ease.reason: A single trigger and email action can be mocked with operator-supplied test inputs, but no attached source documents this provider setup.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: workflow consultants may value simpler notification setup; this request establishes no paying AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can test one trigger and a test inbox; actual SMTP configuration, delivery and failures remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A configured trigger could send repeatedly, but a person must authorize credentials, test delivery and handle failures.

evidence.reason: The request explicitly names sending email through a provider after another app trigger, but gives no frequency or constraints.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (mean 4.6): the bounded test is concrete, but the supplied sources do not support setup mechanics or establish demand for an AI service.

evidence.reason: The post requests debugging and finishing an existing build, but identifies no failure or repeatable diagnostic output.
